# Risk level

How the low / medium / high level is worked out (B02 §7.4). The level always carries its disclaimer; it is not a rating or advice.

!!! warning "Provisional"
    The thresholds and reference scores below are placeholders made up for development, not measured. A local run over 2018–2023 IPOs replaces them.

## Points

| Source | Points |
| --- | --- |
| Red flag marked concern | 2 |
| Red flag marked watch | 1 |
| Rare serious risk (high seriousness, novelty below 0.1) | 1 each, at most 4 |

The score is the points divided by the most points the checks that could run were able to give, so a missing check never looks like a clean record.

## Thresholds

| Level | Score |
| --- | --- |
| Low | below 0.2 |
| Medium | 0.2 to below 0.4 |
| High | 0.4 and above |
